outline: 本課程將介紹：1.電磁波光學2.高斯光束3.共振腔理論4. 原子輻射5.雷射與放大器原理7.雷射特性 8.雷射的應用
schedule:
2/22    Introduction
3/8	Wave optics
3/15	Ray Tracing in Optical System
3/22	Gaussian Beams in Optical Media
3/29	Optical Resonator and Cavity Theory
4/12	Atomic Radiation
4/19	Laser Oscillation, Amplification
4/26	Laser Characteristics, Category, and Applications
5/3	Quiz
assessment:
Homework – 3 problem sets (45%)
Quiz – 25%
Final – oral presentation (30%)
